roadmap.title: Peaceful survival run
roadmap.description: Start NEW STORY on Casual. Read the SURVIVORS instructions before playing and use BOOKWORM as a magazine checklist throughout both runs. For the first run, choose ENDURE in Broken, sleep in the abandoned car in Fugitives, and sneak past the police in On the Run. Recruit John, keep Hank friendly, spare the Tracis and Chloe, and protect Simon by leaving him on the tower roof and having Connor investigate the kitchen. Use a peaceful protest and demonstration; save Luther twice and cross the border without a sacrifice. Win every fight. Play chapters consecutively whenever a later outcome depends on an earlier choice.

roadmap.title: Collect the revolution-only bus-terminal article
roadmap.description: Before replacing the survival run, replay Night of the Soul with saving enabled and select REVOLUTION. Continue into Battle for Detroit with Kara free, then read magazine No. 46 beside the luggage on the right of the bus terminal. This preserves the article before the next run sends Kara to the recycling center.

roadmap.title: Connor death run and opposite choices
roadmap.description: Start NEW STORY and follow I’LL BE BACK for all eight required deaths without skipping chapters. Keep Kara, Alice, and Markus alive. Choose PUSH LEO in Broken, sleep at Ralph’s squat, kill the Tracis, shoot the fleeing Stratford employee, conduct a violent Capitol Park riot, attack in Freedom March, and remain a machine as Connor. Read the changed magazine articles along the way. Have Kara surrender in Crossroads; let Markus win the revolution and free her from the camp.

roadmap.title: Alternate scenes and magazine cleanup
roadmap.description: Use chapter select with saving enabled to connect Connor to Simon and to let CyberLife control Connor at the end. When an outcome needs an earlier decision, replay every intervening chapter rather than jumping ahead. Finish the remaining magazine variants and spend 20,000 points in Extras.

achievements.description: Finish the story with all ten main characters alive.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with all ten main characters alive.

guide.context: Only the listed characters determine this ending; deaths among unrelated police officers or pursued deviants do not prevent it.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Kara, Alice, Luther, Jerry, Connor, Hank, Markus, North, Josh, and Simon} alive. Use a continuous Casual run and win the combat prompts.

As Kara, escape Todd and the police, survive Zlatko, and hide everyone successfully during @loc{Midnight Train}. Save Luther when he is wounded in @loc{Crossroads}, then choose PLAY DEAD and DON’T MOVE.

As Markus, recruit John in @loc{Spare Parts}. Spare the fleeing worker in @loc{The Stratford Tower}, carry Simon onto the roof, and leave him alive. As Connor in @loc{Public Enemy}, investigate the kitchen instead of the roof so Simon can return to Jericho.

Keep Markus peaceful in @loc{Capitol Park} and spare the officers. At @loc{Freedom March}, use STAND GROUND twice and SACRIFICE only with John available to rescue Markus. During @loc{Crossroads}, intervene to save Josh and return for North.
Keep Hank friendly. Learn his dog’s name, Sumo, at the station and inspect the photograph of Cole on his kitchen table in @loc{Russian Roulette}.

In @loc{Public Enemy}, question the leftmost kitchen android. Remove the knife from Connor’s hand, retrieve his biocomponent, and follow the android into the hall. Choose TAKE GUN to stop him and keep his body available as evidence.

In @loc{Last Chance, Connor}, let Hank distract Perkins, then take the key from Hank’s desk. In the evidence room, enter FUCKINGPASSWORD. Transfer component 3983v from Daniel to the broadcast android and attempt to trick him. Copy Markus’s voice from the recording on the central shelf, then use that voice to ask the android for Jericho’s location.
Make Connor deviant in @loc{Crossroads} and have Markus TRUST him in @loc{Night of the Soul}.
Choose DEMONSTRATION for Markus. Refuse Perkins’s bargain, win the final defense, and choose SING or KISS NORTH with high public support.

As Kara in @loc{Battle for Detroit}, rescue Luther and Jerry with the nearby brick. Use the short checkpoint route: begin with ALICE EXCUSE and STAY CALM, say Alice is COLD, then select DO NOTHING for both of the guard’s final actions. Keep the mother’s dropped bus tickets and take the bus. At the border, select NO SACRIFICE while Markus leads the peaceful demonstration.

At CyberLife Tower, have Connor defeat the guards and his double, save Hank, and answer SUMO and COLE. Convert the stored androids. During Amanda’s final takeover, activate the blue handprint panel in the snowy garden.

achievements.description: Play the first chapter
achievements.summary: Finish the opening chapter, The Hostage.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Hostage}, regardless of Emma’s or Connor’s fate.

achievements.description: Spend a total of 20,000 bonus points on Extras.
achievements.summary: Spend a total of 20,000 bonus points on Extras.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Extras} from the main menu and buy bonus content until you have spent 20,000 points. Unlock new flowchart branches during replays if you need more points.

achievements.description: Rescue Emma during the rooftop standoff in The Hostage.
achievements.summary: Rescue Emma during the rooftop standoff in The Hostage.

steps.text: In @loc{The Hostage}, reconstruct the dead police officer’s final moments beside the kitchen. Collect his pistol from beneath the kitchen table.
On the balcony, approach @npc{Daniel} and choose to shoot him when the option appears.

achievements.description: Discover what Alice has hidden inside her box.
achievements.summary: Discover what Alice has hidden inside her box.

steps.text: In @loc{A New Home}, finish the upstairs chores, including Alice’s bed and window. Speak to Alice using FRIENDLY, NAME KARA, INTERESTS?, then SEEM QUIET.
Use Alice’s key on the wooden box on the cupboard opposite her tent. Examine the contents.

achievements.description: Locate Carlos Ortiz’s android in the attic.
achievements.summary: Locate Carlos Ortiz’s android in the attic.

steps.text: In @loc{Partners}, scan the crime scene and reconstruct the attack using the kitchen bat and the victim’s body.
Tell Hank the attack began “…IN THE KITCHEN” and used “…WITH THE BAT.” Next choose “THE ANDROID STABBED THE VICTIM,” followed by “…THE LIVING ROOM,” then “…WITH THE KNIFE.”
Inspect the missing ladder’s marks in the hallway and the handprint at the attic hatch. Set the kitchen chair beneath the hatch, climb up, and search the far end of the attic.

achievements.description: Get Kara and Alice out of Todd’s house alive.
achievements.summary: Get Kara and Alice out of Todd’s house alive.

steps.text: During @loc{A New Home}, open the window in Alice’s bedroom.
In @loc{Stormy Night}, move despite Todd’s order and break Kara’s programming. Go straight to Alice’s room, choose LOCK ROOM, then use the window with GO OUT and JOIN ALICE.
Carry Alice down the pipe and reach the bus.

achievements.description: Push Leo away as Markus in Broken.
achievements.summary: Push Leo away as Markus in Broken.

steps.text: In @loc{Broken}, break Markus’s programming during Leo’s assault and select @mechanic{PUSH LEO}.

achievements.description: Have Markus endure Leo’s attack without pushing him.
achievements.summary: Have Markus endure Leo’s attack without pushing him.

steps.text: In @loc{Broken}, break Markus’s programming and select @mechanic{ENDURE} when Leo attacks.

achievements.description: Obtain a spoken confession from Carlos Ortiz’s android.
achievements.summary: Obtain a spoken confession from Carlos Ortiz’s android.

guide.context: Probing the android’s memory does not count as a confession.

steps.text: Find the attic android in @loc{Partners} to unlock @loc{The Interrogation}.

Keep the android’s stress in the marked target band. On Casual, aim between 50% and 75%; use threats to raise stress and reassurance to lower stress. Choose CONVINCE IT rather than probing its memory.
Finish questioning after the android confesses. When leaving, intervene each time the officers threaten the android.

achievements.description: Spend the night with Alice in the motel or Ralph’s abandoned house.
achievements.summary: Spend the night with Alice in the motel or Ralph’s abandoned house.

steps.text: In @loc{Fugitives}, enter the fenced area containing the abandoned car behind the bus stop. Take the wire cutters from the yellow generator and cut the fence leading to the house.
When Ralph confronts Kara, choose ANDROID, HOSPITALITY, then STAY.
Inside, collect paper behind Alice, matches from the counter, and wood beside the door to light a fire. Use the pillows near the stairs to make Alice’s bed, comfort her, and sleep beside her.

achievements.description: Examine every clue about Hank at his police-station desk.
achievements.summary: Examine every clue about Hank at his police-station desk.

steps.text: In @loc{Waiting for Hank…}, find Hank’s desk, sit down, then stand up before he arrives.
Listen to his headphones, use the telephone, and scan all eight clues on the desk. While scanning, turn to the board on the right and examine its articles.
After the briefing, the DOG, BASKETBALL, MUSIC, and ANTI-ANDROIDS dialogue topics should be available. Choose DOG and MUSIC if you want to improve Hank’s relationship.

achievements.description: Escape the police with both Kara and Alice alive in On the Run.
achievements.summary: Escape the police with both Kara and Alice alive in On the Run.

steps.text: In @loc{On the Run}, keep Kara and Alice alive until they escape. If the police chase them onto the highway, choose GIVE UP as Connor at the fence, then complete Kara’s crossing prompts.

achievements.description: Catch up to Rupert during the rooftop pursuit.
achievements.summary: Catch up to Rupert during the rooftop pursuit.

steps.text: In @loc{The Nest}, examine the bathroom stool and fallen birdcage in Rupert’s apartment. Reconstruct both scenes, then check the ceiling hideout to begin the chase.
Keep up with Rupert through the chase. When Hank is left hanging from the roof, select @mechanic{CHASE DEVIANT} and complete the pursuit.

achievements.description: Pull Hank back to safety during the pursuit in The Nest.
achievements.summary: Pull Hank back to safety during the pursuit in The Nest.

steps.text: In @loc{The Nest}, examine the bathroom stool and fallen birdcage in Rupert’s apartment. Reconstruct both scenes, then check the ceiling hideout to begin the chase.
When Rupert knocks Hank over the roof’s edge, choose @mechanic{SAVE HANK}.

achievements.description: Escape Zlatko’s house with Kara and Alice alive.
achievements.summary: Escape Zlatko’s house with Kara and Alice alive.

steps.text: In @loc{Zlatko}, escape the reset machine by pushing the trolley at the lower left and pulling the green cable at the upper right. Free the androids behind the basement door.
Go upstairs past Luther to the last room in the corridor and collect Alice. Enter the adjacent room and hide under its table until Luther leaves.
Use the fireplace to start a fire. Cross through the bedroom into the corridor, run downstairs, and choose BACK DOOR. Complete the escape prompts.

achievements.description: Kill the two fugitive Tracis at the Eden Club.
achievements.summary: Kill the two fugitive Tracis at the Eden Club.

steps.text: In @loc{The Eden Club}, examine the bodies and question the damaged android. Ask Hank to pay for android 9, then trace the blue-haired Traci through the club’s android memories: the pole near the entrance, the opposite pole, android 29 in the red room, android 23 in the blue room, and the janitor in that room.
Enter the STAFF ONLY warehouse. Search the androids at the back near the blue crate and win the fight.
Select @mechanic{SHOOT} when Connor aims at the Tracis.

achievements.description: Let both fugitive Tracis escape from the Eden Club.
achievements.summary: Let both fugitive Tracis escape from the Eden Club.

steps.text: In @loc{The Eden Club}, examine the bodies and question the damaged android. Ask Hank to pay for android 9, then trace the blue-haired Traci through the club’s android memories: the pole near the entrance, the opposite pole, android 29 in the red room, android 23 in the blue room, and the janitor in that room.
Enter the STAFF ONLY warehouse. Search the androids at the back near the blue crate and win the fight.
Select @mechanic{SPARE} when Connor aims at the Tracis.

achievements.description: Return from the CyberLife warehouse with the stolen supplies for Jericho.
achievements.summary: Return from the CyberLife warehouse with the stolen supplies for Jericho.

steps.text: In @loc{Spare Parts}, disable the patrolling drone using the route preview. Open the supplies crate.
When the maintenance android arrives, choose GRAB AND HIDE, then RELEASE so he deals with the human guard. Collect the supplies from the remaining crate.
Before leaving, open the large container and FREE THEM to awaken its androids. ACCEPT John into the group, then return to Jericho with the supplies.

achievements.description: Have Hank shoot Connor during their conversation at the bridge.
achievements.summary: Have Hank shoot Connor during their conversation at the bridge.

steps.text: Make Hank hostile before @loc{The Bridge}: spill his drink in @loc{Partners}, discuss BASKETBALL and ANTI-ANDROIDS at the station, and shoot the Tracis in @loc{The Eden Club}.
At the bridge, choose COLD, AGGRESSIVE, LIE, and NO as those choices appear. When Hank points his gun at Connor, select @mechanic{DEFY}.

achievements.description: Give Alice a ride on the carousel at Pirates’ Cove.
achievements.summary: Give Alice a ride on the carousel at Pirates’ Cove.

steps.text: In @loc{The Pirates’ Cove}, choose PROTECT ALICE when the Jerries arrive. Go outside with them, switch on the carousel, and help Alice onto a horse.

achievements.description: Finish Markus’s broadcast with no alarm and no injured or dead teammates.
achievements.summary: Finish Markus’s broadcast with no alarm and no injured or dead teammates.

steps.text: In @loc{The Stratford Tower}, use RUSE on the guards outside the broadcast room and complete the takeover without failed prompts.
Shoot the employee who runs from the broadcast room before he can raise the alarm. Deliver Markus’s message and escape from the roof with the whole team.

achievements.description: Read Simon’s memories through Connor’s connection in Public Enemy.
achievements.summary: Read Simon’s memories through Connor’s connection in Public Enemy.

guide.context: This encounter kills Simon. Use this route after finishing the run where everyone survives.

steps.text: In @loc{The Stratford Tower}, spare the fleeing employee. Help the wounded Simon onto the roof and leave him alive when the group escapes.
Play onward to @loc{Public Enemy}. As Connor, follow the blue blood on the roof to the shed and open it. Choose CHARGE DEVIANT and complete the prompts to connect with Simon.

achievements.description: Complete a peaceful android protest in Capitol Park.
achievements.summary: Complete a peaceful android protest in Capitol Park.

steps.text: In @loc{Capitol Park}, inspect the CyberLife store’s camera and have the digging android disable it. Take down the patrol drone using the scaffolding route. Hack the alarm at the construction site and have the snow-clearing androids block the road. Climb into the locked truck enclosure and collect the pliers. Cut the lock, steal the truck, and drive through the store window. Convert the androids inside.
Keep the protest peaceful: paint slogans, change the screens, move cars, and hang the flag. Refuse North’s firebomb and spare the captured police officers.

achievements.description: Complete a violent android protest in Capitol Park.
achievements.summary: Complete a violent android protest in Capitol Park.

steps.text: In @loc{Capitol Park}, inspect the CyberLife store’s camera and have the digging android disable it. Take down the patrol drone using the scaffolding route. Hack the alarm at the construction site and have the snow-clearing androids block the road. Climb into the locked truck enclosure and collect the pliers. Cut the lock, steal the truck, and drive through the store window. Convert the androids inside.

Choose destructive actions throughout the protest: smash benches and windows, overturn cars, and wreck the statue. Accept North’s firebomb and burn the cars. Choose REVENGE when the captured officers are brought forward.

achievements.description: Send the police officer away from Rose’s house without exposing the androids.
achievements.summary: Send the police officer away from Rose’s house without exposing the androids.

steps.text: In @loc{Midnight Train}, send Luther and Alice UPSTAIRS when the officer knocks. Hide the uniform beside the TV, close the cupboard beneath the stairs, and close the laundry-room door. Leave the kitchen magazine showing World War Three and calm Adam.
Open the front door and make the officer coffee. Say ALICE when he asks about the child, deny having androids, and say TIRED about Adam. Explain the laundry noise with WASHING MACHINE.

achievements.description: Lead an attack on the police during Freedom March.
achievements.summary: Lead an attack on the police during Freedom March.

steps.text: At the police standoff in @loc{Freedom March}, choose @mechanic{ATTACK}. Win the resulting fight.

achievements.description: Have Markus stand his ground against the police in Freedom March and survive.
achievements.summary: Have Markus stand his ground against the police in Freedom March and survive.

steps.text: In @loc{Spare Parts}, ACCEPT John into the group so he can save Markus later.
At the end of @loc{Freedom March}, select STAND GROUND twice, then SACRIFICE. John intervenes and keeps Markus alive.

achievements.description: Shoot Chloe during Kamski’s test.
achievements.summary: Shoot Chloe during Kamski’s test.

steps.text: In @loc{Meet Kamski}, choose @mechanic{SHOOT} when Kamski challenges Connor to kill Chloe.

achievements.description: Spare Chloe when Kamski orders Connor to shoot her.
achievements.summary: Spare Chloe when Kamski orders Connor to shoot her.

steps.text: In @loc{Meet Kamski}, choose @mechanic{DON’T SHOOT} during Kamski’s test.

achievements.description: Determine Jericho’s location from police evidence as Connor.
achievements.summary: Determine Jericho’s location from police evidence as Connor.

steps.text: In @loc{Public Enemy}, question the leftmost kitchen android. After he attacks, remove the knife and recover Connor’s biocomponent. Follow the android into the hallway and choose TAKE GUN to stop him.

In @loc{Meet Kamski}, do not obtain Jericho’s location from Kamski. In @loc{Last Chance, Connor}, let Hank distract Perkins; if Hank refuses, release the prisoner from the cells behind Fowler’s office instead. Then take the evidence-room key from Hank’s desk.
Enter the evidence room and use the password @mechanic{FUCKINGPASSWORD}. Move component 3983v from Daniel’s body to the broadcast android.
Attempt to trick the repaired android, then play Markus’s broadcast recording from the central shelf and copy his voice. Speak to the android in Markus’s voice to learn Jericho’s location.

achievements.description: Reach Crossroads with Kara, Markus, and Connor all present.
achievements.summary: Reach Crossroads with Kara, Markus, and Connor all present.

steps.text: Keep Kara and Markus alive through their earlier chapters. As Connor, find Jericho before he is decommissioned, then reach @loc{Crossroads} with all three protagonists.

achievements.description: Detonate Jericho’s explosives as Markus or deviant Connor.
achievements.summary: Detonate Jericho’s explosives as Markus or deviant Connor.

steps.text: In @loc{Crossroads}, choose BLOW UP JERICHO when deciding how to stop the raid. Reach the explosives through the ship, defeat the soldiers, and complete the detonator prompts.

achievements.description: Win Markus’s assault on the camps and free the detained androids.
achievements.summary: Win Markus’s assault on the camps and free the detained androids.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{REVOLUTION} as Markus in @loc{Night of the Soul}.

During @loc{Battle for Detroit}, advance between cover positions and order COVERING FIRE before exposed moves. At the machine-gun positions, have one group provide covering fire while the other groups CHARGE. Complete the combat prompts and fire the rocket launcher at the tanks.
If Connor remains a machine, make him lose the rooftop confrontation and any later fight against Markus.

achievements.description: Make the soldiers withdraw from Markus’s peaceful demonstration.
achievements.summary: Make the soldiers withdraw from Markus’s peaceful demonstration.

guide.context: The peaceful ending depends on public opinion being high enough to make the president spare the androids.

steps.text: Build public support with a peaceful broadcast in @loc{The Stratford Tower} and a peaceful protest in @loc{Capitol Park}. Spare the fleeing broadcaster and the captured officers.
Choose DEMONSTRATION in @loc{Night of the Soul}. At the barricade, refuse Perkins’s offer and survive the soldiers’ attack.
At the final standoff, select @mechanic{SING}, or KISS NORTH if she and Markus are lovers.

achievements.description: Get Kara and Alice out of the android recycling center alive.
achievements.summary: Get Kara and Alice out of the android recycling center alive.

steps.text: At the end of Kara’s escape in @loc{Crossroads}, choose SURRENDER, then OBEY to enter the recycling-center route. Have Markus choose REVOLUTION in @loc{Night of the Soul}.
In the camp, follow the guards’ orders and reassure Alice. In the first enclosure, talk to both Jerries to locate Alice.
In the final lines, ask Jerry to distract the guards. Reach Alice while staying outside the drone’s spotlight. Keep Kara and Alice alive while Markus wins the assault and liberates the camp.

achievements.description: Cross the Canadian border with Kara and Alice alive.
achievements.summary: Cross the Canadian border with Kara and Alice alive.

steps.text: In @loc{Crossroads}, help the wounded Luther. At the end of Kara’s escape, select PLAY DEAD, then DON’T MOVE.
In @loc{Battle for Detroit}, sneak past the soldiers. Rescue Luther and Jerry by taking the brick behind the nearby car and knocking out their guard.
Take the short route through the checkpoint. Begin with ALICE EXCUSE, then select STAY CALM. Explain that Alice is COLD. Choose DO NOTHING for each of the guard’s final two actions.
At the bus terminal, approach the mother with her baby on the left. Collect the tickets she drops, choose KEEP TICKETS both times, and board the bus.
At Canadian border control, choose NO SACRIFICE while Markus leads a peaceful demonstration and public opinion supports the androids.

achievements.description: Awaken the androids stored beneath CyberLife Tower as Connor.
achievements.summary: Awaken the androids stored beneath CyberLife Tower as Connor.

steps.text: During @loc{Russian Roulette}, inspect the photograph on Hank’s kitchen table to learn about Cole. Later, become deviant in @loc{Crossroads} and have Markus TRUST Connor in @loc{Night of the Soul}.
At @loc{CyberLife Tower}, hack the elevator camera and defeat the two guards. Use AGENT 54 VOICE to send the elevator to floor -49.

Approach the stored androids. When Connor’s double threatens Hank, choose SAVE HANK, then INTERPOSE and win the fight. Answer @npc{SUMO} and @npc{COLE} when Hank questions Connor, then convert the androids.

achievements.description: Have Connor kill the deviant leader during Battle for Detroit.
achievements.summary: Have Connor kill the deviant leader during Battle for Detroit.

guide.context: Killing the deviant leader in Crossroads does not count.

steps.text: Use a @loc{Battle for Detroit} ending where deviant Connor has converted CyberLife’s androids and Markus has won his demonstration or revolution.
When Amanda takes Connor into the snowy garden during Markus’s final speech, wait without activating the handprint panel. CyberLife takes control and Connor shoots Markus.

achievements.description: Break CyberLife’s attempt to control Connor during the final speech.
achievements.summary: Break CyberLife’s attempt to control Connor during the final speech.

steps.text: Keep deviant Connor alive through the CyberLife mission and let Markus win his demonstration or revolution.

When Amanda takes control during the final speech in @loc{Battle for Detroit}, find the blue handprint panel between the two lamps beside a tree in the snowy garden. Use the scan view to highlight the panel and activate it before time runs out.

achievements.description: Keep Connor a machine during the confrontation in Crossroads.
achievements.summary: Keep Connor a machine during the confrontation in Crossroads.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Crossroads} as Connor and select @mechanic{REMAIN A MACHINE} when the deviant leader confronts him.

achievements.description: Have Connor break his programming and become deviant.
achievements.summary: Have Connor break his programming and become deviant.

steps.text: Raise Connor’s software instability: save Hank in @loc{The Nest}, spare the Tracis in @loc{The Eden Club}, and refuse to shoot Chloe in @loc{Meet Kamski}. Show empathy in conversations and avoid Connor’s deaths.
In @loc{Crossroads}, choose @mechanic{BECOME A DEVIANT} and break through the programming barrier.

achievements.description: Finish the story without losing any fight.
achievements.summary: Finish the story without losing any fight.

steps.text: Start a story run on @mechanic{Casual} and win every combat sequence you encounter. Pay particular attention to the Traci fight in @loc{The Eden Club} and the final-chapter battles. Finish the story on that run.

achievements.description: Read all 46 numbered magazine articles.
achievements.summary: Read all 46 numbered magazine articles.

guide.context: Most magazines contain two numbered articles. Read both topics and all pages, then check Extras > Magazines. Articles stay collected across story runs. When changing a choice to obtain a different article, play every chapter from that choice to the magazine with saving enabled. Finish the chapter containing your final missing article. The list follows chapter order, but alternate articles require different runs.

achievements.description: Finish the story with Hank’s relationship to Connor at Friend.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with Hank’s relationship to Connor at Friend.

steps.text: Build Hank’s friendship: buy him a drink in @loc{Partners}, discuss DOG and MUSIC at the station, save him in @loc{The Nest}, and spare the Tracis and Chloe. Use respectful, sympathetic replies.
Keep the relationship at @mechanic{Friend} through the end of @loc{Battle for Detroit}. Becoming deviant and saving Hank at CyberLife Tower fits this route.

achievements.description: Finish the story with Kara, Alice, and Luther alive together.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with Kara, Alice, and Luther alive together.

steps.text: In @loc{Crossroads}, help the wounded Luther. At the end of Kara’s escape, select PLAY DEAD, then DON’T MOVE.
In @loc{Battle for Detroit}, sneak past the soldiers. Rescue Luther and Jerry by taking the brick behind the nearby car and knocking out their guard.
Take the short route through the checkpoint. Begin with ALICE EXCUSE, then select STAY CALM. Explain that Alice is COLD. Choose DO NOTHING for each of the guard’s final two actions.
At the bus terminal, approach the mother with her baby on the left. Collect the tickets she drops, choose KEEP TICKETS both times, and board the bus.
At Canadian border control, choose NO SACRIFICE while Markus leads a peaceful demonstration and public opinion supports the androids.

achievements.description: Have Connor die and return at every possible opportunity before Battle for Detroit in one continuous story run.
achievements.summary: Have Connor die and return at every possible opportunity before Battle for Detroit in one continuous story run.

guide.context: Eight deaths are required before Battle for Detroit. Skipping chapters does not carry a changed choice into later chapters.

steps.text: Begin a NEW STORY. Play every chapter in sequence through @loc{Night of the Soul}. Keep Kara, Alice, and Markus alive for the later achievements and magazines; use Experienced for Connor’s fatal action sequences.
@loc{The Hostage}: approach Daniel, agree to remove the helicopter, and keep moving close enough to select SACRIFICE SELF. Connor must die while saving Emma.

@loc{Partners}: spill Hank’s drink and find the android in the attic. In @loc{The Interrogation}, probe the android’s memory until stress reaches 100%, leave your chair, give a COLD response, then INTERVENE when the android resists the officers. He shoots Connor.

In @loc{Waiting for Hank…}, inspect all eight clues on Hank’s desk and examine the articles on the board to its right before Hank arrives. During the later conversation at the desks, select the newly unlocked BASKETBALL and ANTI-ANDROIDS topics to worsen his relationship.

@loc{On the Run}: let the police find Kara and Alice. Get Kara safely across the first carriageway. As Connor, choose GO and complete the prompts to enter the highway, then fail his traffic prompts so a vehicle kills him. Complete Kara’s remaining prompts to keep her and Alice alive.
@loc{The Nest}: locate Rupert and start the rooftop pursuit. After the first glass-roof slide beyond the greenhouse, fail the jump prompts so Connor falls to his death.
In @loc{The Eden Club}, shoot the Tracis to keep Hank hostile. At @loc{The Bridge}, use COLD, AGGRESSIVE, LIE, NO, and DEFY so Hank shoots Connor.

@loc{Public Enemy}: question the leftmost kitchen android. Recover Connor’s biocomponent after the attack, follow the android into the hallway, and choose SAVE HANK. Connor dies shielding Hank; the android’s body remains available as evidence.

@loc{Meet Kamski}: if you shoot Chloe, ask about any topic except JERICHO LOCATION. In @loc{Last Chance, Connor}, release the prisoner to distract Perkins, take Hank’s evidence-room key, and choose LEAVE when Gavin stops you.

Find Jericho in the evidence room: enter FUCKINGPASSWORD, transfer component 3983v from Daniel to the broadcast android, attempt to trick him, then copy Markus’s voice from the recording and question him again. Lose the fight against Gavin on the way out so Connor is shot.

@loc{Crossroads}: choose REMAIN A MACHINE. When the soldier orders Connor to stop during the raid, select RUN and let him shoot Connor. Continue into @loc{Night of the Soul} for Connor’s return and the achievement.
